latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Highlight Editor Online — Extract and Export Video Highlights.

- Lets users upload raw video footage and use simple text instructions to extract and compile highlight reels.
- Supports popular video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB.
- Automatic token handling with free starter credits if no API key is set.
- Cloud render pipeline: generates 1080p MP4 highlight clips in 1-2 minutes.
- Quick actions for upload, export, credits checking, and timeline previews.
- Handles common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- User-friendly error handling and guidance for best results.
